mmm.description: Build a Simba MMM from uploaded or pipeline data. Use for data preparation, model creation and fit recovery; use results guidance for existing-model questions.

results.description: Read and interpret existing Simba MMM results, channel contribution, ROI, uncertainty and diagnostics. Use for results questions without loading model-building instructions.

priors.description: Construct Simba media or control prior overrides. Use before changing carryover, saturation anchors, effect-at-average coordinates or explicit control transforms.

optimiser.description: Set up Simba budget optimisation and inspect saved optimiser or scenario runs. Use for channel bounds, laydown, margins and decision-versus-comparison interpretation.

studies.description: Author, edit and review Simba Studies, recipes, policies and runs. Use for immutable publication, launch recovery, diagnostics and human handoff.

var.description: Build and inspect Simba VAR models and linked long-run MMM results. Use for long-term effects, VAR fit recovery and long-run rollup interpretation.

campaigns.description: Inspect campaign facts, mapping, incrementality, conditional budgets and experiment screening. Preserve platform versus incremental evidence and explicit write boundaries.

reporting.description: Find an existing dataset and report actual KPI and spend with declared roles, exact source identity and aggregation. No upload, refresh or fit.
